title: OKR Mastery: Align Goals and Drive Team Success
description:

What You’ll Learn:
•
Effective Goal Setting:

•
Alignment Across Levels:
Learn to synchronize company goals with the goals of departments and employees, ensuring transparency and motivation.
•
Practical Implementation:
Get practical tools and templates for implementing OKR in your teams.
Course Program:
1.
OKR Basics for Managers and Employees:
• What is OKR? Definition and basic principles.
• History and success stories of OKR implementation in companies (Google, Intel, etc.).
• How OKRs help synchronize strategic management with everyday tasks.
• The role of the manager in the process of setting and managing OKRs.
• Focus on critical objectives (OKRs) and their proper formulation.
• How OKRs motivate teams to achieve high results.
2.
Launching OKR in the Company and Setting Goals:
• Preparing managers and teams for OKR launch.
• Organization of the first meeting on setting goals and key results.
• Practicing goal setting on the principle of “from X to Y to Z”.
• How to use emotional and rational arguments to sell OKRs to employees.
• Implementing change using John Kotter’s 8 change accelerators.
• Managing expectations and supporting change at all levels of the company.
3.
Working with OKRs in the Loop:
• Overview of OKR cycles: planning, monitoring, and evaluation.
• Organizing regular meetings to track progress and solve problems.
• How to adjust goals and maintain flexibility in the OKR process.
• The role of managers in monitoring and supporting OKR implementation.
• Learning from real cases of companies that have successfully implemented OKRs.
• The importance of leading indicators for success.
4.
Completing the Cycle and Summarizing the Results:
• Evaluating the fulfillment of OKRs and setting new goals.
• Organization of final meetings to discuss results between managers and employees.
• Motivation and development of employees based on OKR results.
• Using OKR results to improve processes and achieve strategic goals.
